nodes.rationale: Keep reported, inferred and missing conditions separate; proposed transfer checks are not author-validated facts.

nodes.rationale: Check actual combined backgrounds against 4.5:1 text and 3:1 meaningful non-text contrast; test light, dark and increased contrast.

nodes.label: Role-based Liquid Glass placement
nodes.rationale: Use material effects for floating controls, with existing macOS vibrancy; CSS blur does not reproduce optical refraction.

nodes.label: Opaque reading and input surfaces
nodes.rationale: Keep PDF, analysis, tables and form content on stable opaque bg/surface backgrounds for legibility.

nodes.label: SaveBar success and failure feedback
nodes.rationale: While saving disable edits; success dismisses SaveBar; failure preserves message and retry action.

nodes.label: Single-column responsive settings form
nodes.rationale: Maximum 44rem width, 40px minimum rows, aligned labels and controls; narrow layouts move controls below labels.

nodes.label: Single material layer
nodes.rationale: Avoid stacked vibrancy and backdrop-filter because overlapping transparent surfaces obscure boundaries.

nodes.label: Truthful form and save states
nodes.rationale: Focus, errors, saving, failure, disabled and completed states follow real application state and are not distinguished by color alone.

nodes.label: Settings viewport and accessibility QA
nodes.rationale: Exercise 1400x900 and 1024x680, long Korean strings, all form states, reduced motion and reduced transparency.
